This position is ideal for someone who enjoys turning ideas and designs into interactive products while balancing functionality, scalability, and user experience.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and maintain responsive web applications and user interfaces
Translate UI/UX designs into clean, scalable, and reusable frontend code
Build interactive features and optimize applications for speed and performance
Collaborate with backend developers, designers, and product teams to deliver seamless user experiences
Ensure cross-browser compatibility and mobile responsiveness
Integrate frontend applications with APIs and backend services
Debug issues, troubleshoot UI problems, and improve application stability
Participate in code reviews, testing, and frontend architecture discussions
Follow modern frontend development standards and best practices
Stay updated with evolving frontend frameworks, tools, and technologies

Required Skills & Experience

Strong experience in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript
Hands-on experience with frontend frameworks/libraries such as React, Angular, or Vue.js
Good understanding of responsive design, accessibility, and web performance optimization
Experience working with REST APIs and frontend integrations
Familiarity with version control systems like Git
Understanding of state management, component architecture, and reusable UI development
Basic understanding of build tools, deployment workflows, and CI/CD processes is an advantage
Strong debugging and problem-solving abilities
Good communication and collaboration skills

Preferred Qualifications
